newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 27.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:

* NBC told analysts that it expects to increase operating profit 12 percent to 15 percent in 1997, to between $1.1 billion and $1.15 billion, largely driven by growth at the NBC network and CNBC cable network.

* PolyGram Films, the newly formed mainstream U.S. theatrical distribution arm of the global entertainment giant, has filled a number of key distribution positions under president of distribution William Soady.
* Mark Advent, who designed the Las Vegas casino hit "New York/New York" is looking to repeat his success with a planned project called the San Francisco Hotel & Casino.
* Forget about skyrocketing salaries. Actors are now demanding even more perks, such as a Gulfstream jet or an entourage of assistants, from the studios.
* Scott Free Productions, the feature film production company run by brothers Tony and Ridley Scott, has renegotiated its deals with financiers Largo Entertainment and First Independent.
* Filmmakers Francis Ford Coppola and Wayne Wang have launched the first feature project from their Chrome Dragon collaboration.
* Gary Levinsohn and Mark Gordon's production and finance company has created a foreign sales division, and signed a multiyear equity partnership with four of its key foreign distributor-investors.
